meta.title: HAKA PRO — IDX stock research
meta.description: HAKA PRO is a research workspace for Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) stocks: prices, foreign and broker flow, financial statements, insider disclosures and structured analysis, with every number dated.

hero.eyebrow: Research for Indonesia Stock Exchange stocks
hero.title: IDX stock research, with every number dated.
hero.subtitle: HAKA PRO puts prices, foreign and broker flow, financial statements, insider disclosures and structured analysis for every listed company into one calm workspace, and tells you how fresh each figure is.
hero.noteSignedOut: Market data is for signed-in users. Research only: HAKA PRO never tells you what to buy.
hero.noteSignedIn: Research only: HAKA PRO never tells you what to buy.

features.title: Everything you check before a decision, in one place
features.intro: No more jumping between broker apps, exchange PDFs and spreadsheets.

flow.title: Follow the money
flow.body: Daily foreign net buying and selling, broker summaries for any session or date range, top buyers against top sellers with their average prices, and who has been accumulating.

financials.title: Read the fundamentals
financials.body: Income statements, balance sheets and cash flows, quarterly or annual, by year, with a warning when a company's latest report is overdue.

insiders.title: See who traded
insiders.body: Director, commissioner and major-holder disclosures grouped by holder. Custodian accounts are flagged so they aren't mistaken for owners.

analysis.title: Understand the technicals
analysis.body: A score with its contributing factors, moving averages, RSI, MACD, pivot levels, and how similar situations played out in the stock's own history, in plain language.

history.title: Charts and history
history.body: Candles with indicators, a daily price table you can filter by date, monthly seasonality and the trade-by-trade tape for any session.

discover.title: Find ideas
discover.body: Strategy matches that explain why a stock appeared, a screener, market movers, the largest companies by market cap and recent ownership changes.

freshness.title: Every number tells you how old it is
freshness.intro: A price from last Friday shouldn't look like a price from this minute. HAKA PRO labels every dataset with its state and as-of date, and never calls data live when it isn't.

states.DELAYED: Today's session while trading is running, a little behind the exchange.
states.HISTORICAL: A past period or a longer date range.
states.STALE: Older than data that should already be out, such as an overdue financial report.
states.UNAVAILABLE: The date can't be confirmed, so we say so instead of guessing.

freshness.hover: Hover or tap any badge in the app to see the exact date, period and source.

how.title: From ticker to understanding in three steps

steps.title: Search
steps.body: Press Ctrl K (⌘K on Mac) and type a ticker or company name.

steps.title: Get the overview
steps.body: Key metrics, valuation and short observations on price, flow, ownership and financials.

steps.title: Go deeper, then keep watch
steps.body: Open the Flow, Analysis, Financials, Insiders or History tabs, then add the stock to your watchlist and set alerts.

observed.title: Observed, not predicted
observed.body: We describe what happened in the data. Analysis outlooks are labelled as calculations, never as our advice.

neutral.title: Neutral language
neutral.body: No rockets, no must-buys. Brokers are trading firms, not owners, and the app says so.

privacy.title: Your account, your lists
privacy.body: Watchlists and alerts belong to your account. Identity numbers found in public filings are removed before anything is shown.

local.title: Made for Indonesia
local.body: Bahasa Indonesia first, English when you need it, rupiah formatting and the IDX trading calendar built in.

items.a: No. During a trading session prices are delayed, and after the close you see end-of-day data. Every figure shows its as-of date, and the time of the last trade when there is one.
No. HAKA PRO is for research and education. Where an analysis includes an outlook or price levels, it is shown as a calculation from the data, not a recommendation. Decisions are yours.
Companies listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange, more than 900 of them. Daily history starts in January 2020 for most; newer listings start from their listing date.
Yes, to see market data. Your account also keeps your watchlist and alerts.

items.q: Does it work on my phone?
items.a: Yes. HAKA PRO works on phones, tablets and desktops, in a light or dark theme.

items.q: Where does the data come from?
items.a: From Indonesian market data sources covering prices, broker activity, financial reports and disclosures. Each dataset shows its date so you can judge it yourself.

final.title: Start your next IDX research session with the facts.
final.body: Open any listed company and see its prices, flows, fundamentals and disclosures side by side.

footer.tagline: Indonesian equity research by Heulau Lab.
footer.disclaimer: For research and education only, not investment advice. Past results don't predict future ones.

ownershipUpload.title: Upload the ≥1% shareholder list
ownershipUpload.intro: KSEI's monthly ≥1% shareholder list is published only as an announcement on the IDX website, which blocks the engine. Download the file in your browser and upload it here; the engine parses it, stores it and compares it with the previous month.
ownershipUpload.step1: Open the IDX announcements, find the latest above-1% shareholder list and download the PDF:
ownershipUpload.step2: Pick the month of the list's position (not the upload date) and, if there is one, enter the announcement number as the reference.
ownershipUpload.step3: Upload the file. What was read and the per-holder changes appear on Ownership Changes and on each stock's Ownership tab.
ownershipUpload.fileHint: PDF, CSV or XLSX, up to 20 MB. The same file is never processed twice.

sources.title: Sources and method
sources.windows: 1D–30D windows are counted in trading sessions; price change uses the close right before the window.
sources.baseline: Volume, value and average value per trade are compared with the average of the 20 sessions before the latest one.
sources.insider: Insider transactions: {days} calendar days up to the data date.
sources.price: The last price and its change are computed the same way as on the stock page.
